title: Agent Org
description: Sole live configuration at .github/agent-org/org.json. Paths and ownership globs are repository-root-relative, never config-directory-relative. This schema validates structure; owner_validator.py validates managed coverage and tree semantics.

version.description: Org-state version. Bumped by exactly one on every applied split or the explicitly approved v4 -> v5 ConfigRelocation.

root.description: Configured entry node. Bootstrap defaults to main; the Host reads this field.

collaboration.description: agents uses the org workflow; hybrid also reconciles between-run human changes.

scope.description: Repository-root-relative managed code globs, independent of collaboration and stable through splits. Paths outside this scope are unmanaged and allowed; gaps inside it remain UNOWNED. Never infer scope from a Parent's retained domain.

storage.description: local excludes exact overlay files via Git's common info/exclude; tracked leaves them ready for version control. Runtime worktrees and caches remain excluded in both modes.

id.description: Stable, hierarchy-free identifier. Never renamed across reorgs.

parent.description: id of the parent node, or null for the root.

children.description: ids of direct children. Empty for a Leaf.

mode.description: Parent = scatter-gather over children. Leaf = executes directly.

domain.description: Repository-root-relative glob patterns (gitignore semantics) the node owns. For a Parent this is an explicit shared set (root/org/contract files common to its children), never '**'. Effective domain = domain minus excludes.

excludes.description: Globs a node's domain would match but that are owned elsewhere (a cross-cutting sibling). Effective domain = domain minus excludes. A materialized excluded path that no other node covers surfaces as UNOWNED via the owner-oracle; see the agent-org-design skill §2.2, §2.7.
